panels.title: Server uptime
panels.description: Host uptime.

panels.title: Protocols up
panels.description: Protocol engines up out of those monitored (sing-box, xray, WireGuard, AmneziaWG, Telegram, Snowflake, Conduit).

panels.title: Source countries

targets.expr: count(count by (country)(((singbox_active_users_by_country or xray_active_users_by_country or wireguard_active_peers_by_country or amneziawg_active_peers_by_country) or label_replace(conduit_region_connected_clients,"country","$1","region","(.+)") or tor_snowflake_proxy_connections_total)))

panels.description: Distinct source countries across VPN protocols + Conduit + Snowflake bridges.

panels.title: Destination countries
panels.description: Distinct destination countries (sing-box only).

panels.title: Active users by protocol
panels.description: Currently CONNECTED per protocol. WireGuard/AmneziaWG use live peer_active, not the provisioned count.

panels.title: Traffic by protocol (total over range)
panels.description: Total bytes moved per engine over the dashboard time range (default 24h), incl. the Conduit + Snowflake bridges. Conduit typically dominates (it relays for many strangers). Idle provisioned peers move no bytes.

panels.title: Provisioned users (created configs)
panels.description: Created user/peer configs per protocol: sing-box (singbox_total_users), xray (xray_total_users), WireGuard/AmneziaWG (*_peers_total). Telegram/MTProxy exposes no provisioned-user metric. Note: xray/sing-box counts can differ from WG/AWG if a protocol isn't enabled for every user.

panels.title: Active users by protocol over time
panels.description: Connected users per protocol over time.

panels.title: Bridges — relaying for others (not your VPN users)
Conduit clients
panels.description: Clients currently relayed through the Conduit (Psiphon) bridge.

panels.title: Conduit relayed (range)
panels.description: Total bytes relayed by the Conduit bridge over the dashboard range (down+up). Lifetime is ~756 GB; current throughput ~294 KB/s for 31 clients.

panels.title: Conduit reach by country
panels.description: Clients this server relays for as a Conduit bridge, by country (top 15).

panels.title: Snowflake successful
panels.description: Successful Snowflake (Tor) connections. Low here: the proxy mostly times out.

panels.title: Snowflake timeouts
panels.description: Client connections that failed after rendezvous (NAT/censorship). If this dwarfs 'successful', the proxy is reachable but not completing relays.

panels.title: Snowflake reach by country
panels.description: Successful Snowflake connections by client country. Counts are near-1 because the proxy completes very few relays (timeouts >> successes) and rounds low counts for privacy — these are Snowflake's own upstream numbers, not a MoaV miscount.

panels.title: Sources — where your users are from
Source countries — aggregated (VPN + Conduit)

targets.expr: topk(20, sum by (country)(((singbox_active_users_by_country or xray_active_users_by_country or wireguard_active_peers_by_country or amneziawg_active_peers_by_country) or label_replace(conduit_region_connected_clients,"country","$1","region","(.+)"))))

panels.description: Connected users/peers by source country across all VPN protocols + Conduit's relayed clients. Top 20.

panels.title: Source countries by protocol
panels.description: Per-protocol breakdown: how many connected sources per country, split by protocol (sing-box/xray/WireGuard/AmneziaWG/Conduit). The aggregated pie at left is the sum.

panels.title: Bytes by destination port
panels.description: Destination ports. Colours match the protocol pie. Top 14.

panels.title: Bytes by protocol (QUIC/HTTPS split)
panels.description: Ports mapped to protocols, keyed on (port, network): 443/tcp=HTTPS, 443/udp=HTTP/3 (QUIC), 53=DNS, 853=DoT, 19302/3478=STUN. Unmapped fold into 'other'.

panels.title: QUIC share of web (443)
panels.description: Share of port-443 bytes over UDP (HTTP/3 / QUIC) vs TCP (HTTPS).

panels.title: TCP vs UDP
panels.description: Transport split.

panels.title: Port traffic over time
panels.description: Throughput per destination port (top 8).

options.content: **Destination data — sites, ports, protocols and destination countries — is observed by the sing-box exporter only.** Other protocol engines do not emit per-destination metrics. Sites are k-anonymised: those under `SITE_ANALYTICS_MIN_CLIENTS` distinct clients fold into `other`; no client identifier is ever stored.

panels.title: Share of traffic by site
panels.description: Bytes per destination site. 'other' = folded (< k clients).

panels.title: Top sites by connections
panels.description: Cumulative connections per site (top 12).

panels.title: Distinct clients per named site
panels.description: Distinct clients per NAMED site (over the k-anonymity floor). Sites below the floor hide in 'other'.

panels.title: Traffic by destination country
panels.description: Destination geography (sing-box). 'unknown' is the coverage gap by design.

panels.title: Traffic over time by direction
panels.description: Aggregate up/down throughput (sing-box destinations).
